# Katie Steele {#welcome}

Welcome to my portfolio for **MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics** at the
University of Pennsylvania.

This site documents my work in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics program —
weekly notes, course assignments, and a final project applying data analysis to
urban policy questions.

## About Me

I'm a student in the Data Science MSE program at Penn; I'm also the Assistant Director for [PORES](pores.upenn.edu) and the [Fox Leadership Program](foxleadership.upenn.edu) on campus. 
My background is in economics, statistics and quantitative political science research, and I'm excited to learn more about spatial analysis and to apply my skills to new policy datasets.
